about_the_game:
Box Hustle is a 3D isometric Sokoban-inspired puzzle game where strategic movement is key. Push wooden crates onto target spots while navigating tight spaces and avoiding dead ends. With a dynamic camera that rotates along the Y-axis, every move counts as you hustle to solve increasingly challenging levels.

This demo version features 20 levels, offering a taste of the full puzzle experience. Plan ahead, reposition carefully, and master the art of box-moving in this clever and engaging challenge!
